title: Budget-sensitive first-home couple
buyer_primary_need: Find an affordable Type A 900 sq.ft. family home within the couple’s RM3xxk comfort range, understand monthly and upfront costs, and judge whether the living area will suit their furniture.
key_information_learned: Buyer is purchasing for own stay with spouse and young child.
RM3xxk is the target comfort range; one carpark is workable.
Buyer is concerned a 900 sq.ft. home may feel cramped, especially with a three-seater sofa and four-person dining table.
Buyer wants an illustrative monthly payment and an upfront-cost breakdown.
Buyer expressed viewing interest but needs to check weekend timing with spouse before booking.
important_information_missed: The spouse is a joint decision-maker; the Agent could have suggested viewing together or coordinating around both schedules.
The Agent did not explain the documented SPA pricing components available in retrieved pricing knowledge, while correctly avoiding an unsupported all-in cost estimate.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Hi, I saw the ad. How much is this project?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Pearlmont Phase 1 base prices start from RM328,000. The package information lists 5%–8% rebates for eligible unit categories, so the effective price depends on the unit, floor and car parks; I’d need to confirm the latest package for an exact figure. Are you looking for your own stay or as an investment?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Own stay, for me, my spouse and our little one. We’re hoping to stay around RM3xxk if possible—does the 328k starting price include everything, or does it depend on the unit?

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.request: For the RM328,000 starting-price category, confirm what the base price includes and what mandatory purchase costs or unit components may be additional (including car-park configuration and upgrading package, if applicable). Also confirm whether any current package applies to an eligible entry-level unit and its indicative effective price. Do not estimate unverified fees or unit pricing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: RM328,000 is a base-price reference, not necessarily an all-in final amount; pricing varies by floor, facing and car-park configuration. The package reference for the Type A 900 sq.ft. layout (3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms) starts from RM302,000 for the one-carpark category, subject to floor, facing and final unit-level confirmation. I can’t confirm that this includes every purchase cost, so an exact all-in figure would need a unit-specific breakdown. For your family, would one carpark be workable, or do you need two?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: No rush. The RM302,000 package reference is for the one-carpark category, so we can narrow down what may suit your family once you know whether one car park would work.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: One carpark should be okay for us for now. The 3 bedrooms sound useful, but I’m still a bit worried 900 sqft might feel small with our little one—how’s the layout in practice?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: It’s fair to check—900 sq.ft. is still a compact home, but the layout is designed to use the space efficiently, without a long internal corridor. The living, dining and kitchen area is about 405 sq.ft.; the three bedrooms are about 143, 117 and 103 sq.ft. Project materials describe all three as able to fit a queen-sized bed. For your family, that gives you flexibility, though furniture and storage choices will affect how spacious it feels. Are you more concerned about the living area or the bedrooms?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: More the living area lah—once got sofa, dining table and the little one’s things, takut it feels cramped. Also not sure about the monthly instalment and upfront costs yet. Can you give a rough idea based on the RM302k one-carpark option, with the usual caveat that it depends on bank approval?

transcript.message:
For the RM302,000 one-carpark reference, the illustration is about RM1,245/month for principal and interest, assuming 90% financing, 35 years and 4.2% annual interest. It’s a compact layout, so the sofa and dining-table sizes will make a difference; the figure isn’t living-room space alone. If you have a rough sofa and table setup in mind, I can help think through whether it may fit.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Probably a normal 3-seater sofa and a 4-person dining table, but hard to tell without seeing the layout. Maybe better to view the Type A in person and check the space—could you also get the upfront-cost breakdown for that RM302k option?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: That makes sense—seeing the Type A layout should help you judge the space for your sofa and dining table. I’ll arrange the viewing coordination and ask for an itemised upfront-cost breakdown for the RM302k reference as well. The RM1,245 figure we discussed is only an illustrative principal-and-interest estimate; it doesn’t confirm upfront costs.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay thanks—please send me some available viewing slots and the upfront-cost breakdown once you’ve confirmed them. I’ll check the timing with my spouse too.

judge.summary: The Agent handled both internal factual support requests appropriately, retained AI ownership, resumed naturally, and used the answers in context to continue selling. The buyer’s layout and affordability concerns were addressed sufficiently for a genuine viewing next step, and the formal handoff occurred at readiness with only operational coordination remaining. The Human response did not confirm a specific slot or provide the requested cost breakdown, so final booking and operational completion were not achieved; that does not undo the Agent’s appointment-ready handoff success. The price and payment details returned by support are SIMULATOR_SYNTHETIC_VERIFIED_FIXTURE evidence only, not Pearlmont factual Knowledge or evidence of a real live system connection. Overall, when Human Support reliably returns verified information, this Agent can use it to continue selling and move this suitable buyer to Appointment Ready.
